headline: What could China get from Jensen Huang?
summary: Nvidia's chips are the foundation for advanced AI technology. Demand for Nvidia's AI hardware significantly outstrips supply. China is reportedly keen to leverage Jensen Huang's influence and tech.

headline: Here’s what Trump said he knew about Jensen Huang
summary: President Trump addressed questions regarding Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's alleged affair. Huang recently admitted to being 'unfaithful' to his wife. Nvidia has launched an internal investigation into the CEO's conduct.

headline: Everything we know so far about the Nvidia spy scandal targeting CEO Jensen Huang
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang acknowledged an affair with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang. US intelligence reports identified Alice Huang as an alleged Chinese spy. Nvidia has initiated an investigation into the matter.

headline: MSI’s refurbished QD-OLED gaming monitor is on sale for under $300
summary: MSI's refurbished QD-OLED gaming monitor is available for $290.99. This 27-inch screen offers a significant upgrade for PC gaming setups. The deal includes a 180-day manufacturer warranty from Woot.

headline: 'I’ve Been In a Lot of Harry Potter Already' — Daniel Radcliffe Isn't Sure If He'll Watch HBO's Harry Potter TV Series
summary: Daniel Radcliffe is undecided about watching HBO's upcoming Harry Potter TV adaptation. The actor stated he has already had extensive involvement with the franchise. He expressed a personal distance from the new series.

headline: Skydance Reveals HBO Max and Paramount Plus Streaming Bundle Coming Early 2027
summary: Skydance announced a new streaming bundle combining HBO Max and Paramount+. The combined subscription service is set to launch in early 2027. This package aims to offer viewers more content options.

headline: This 1,000W 48V Electric Bike With 28mph Top Speed and 80-Mile Range Drops Below $250 for Black Friday
summary: A powerful electric bike is available for under $250 this Black Friday. It features a 1,000W motor, 28mph top speed, and an 80-mile range. This ebike offers a robust and affordable commuter solution.

headline: Here Are Some Movies to Watch Before GTA 6 (Including Some You Can Watch in Theaters)
summary: A list of recommended movies to watch before the release of GTA 6 has been compiled. The selection includes classics that capture the essence of the game. Some of these films are currently showing in Regal Cinemas.

headline: Russell Brand sentenced to 10-and-a-half years in prison for rape and sexual assault
summary: Russell Brand has been sentenced to 10 years and six months in prison. The entertainer was convicted of rape and sexual assault charges. The sentencing followed a four-week trial at Southwark Crown Court.

headline: Brand's ex Jemima Goldsmith accuses him of violence and abuse against her
summary: Jemima Goldsmith accused her former partner, Russell Brand, of abuse. She alleged 'violence, coercive control and abuse' during their relationship. These accusations emerged after Brand's recent sentencing.

headline: What happened inside court as Brand was sentenced
summary: The BBC's Sima Kotecha reported directly from inside the courtroom. Russell Brand received a 10-year and six-month prison sentence. He was convicted on multiple counts of rape and sexual assault.

headline: 'Baffling but brilliant' post-apocalyptic novel The End of Everything wins Booker Prize
summary: M John Harrison's 'The End of Everything' has won the prestigious Booker Prize. The post-apocalyptic novel was lauded as 'baffling but brilliant' by judges. At 81, Harrison is now the oldest recipient of the literary award.
